lines.text: Good luck today, Commander!
Have you been taking good care of yourself?
You've got to keep yourself in tip-top shape!

Commander, Commander!
Every time I call you, I feel so happy, hee-hee.

Would you like to go on a date with me today?
I just so happen to have some time off, hee-hee.

Commander, work is important but you know that rest is important too, right?
Rest is also a kind of work y'know.

Commander? We've got work to do.
When are you gonna show up?
C'mon Commander, where are you? I have to admit though, even waiting for him feels nice.
It's a super nice day today!
How can I put it... It's just that the Outpost feels so... full of life!
Have you come for a physical, Commander?
Even if there is only a 1% chance, you can be cured!
Tougher in both body and soul!
I'm stronger, Commander!
It's all thanks to you!
A present for me? Really?
Thank you!
Wow, I'm so touched!
The Commander... is someone I can see myself falling in love with.

I want to spend more time with you.
May I get closer to you?
It's a great pleasure knowing you, Commander!
Let's step on it!
Present! Awaiting your orders!
Should I go over there?
Enemy incoming!
Keep it up!
We can win!
I hope nobody gets hurt!
Reloading!
This is tougher than I expected.
I can do this!
It's my turn!
Don't give up! Let me help!
Come on! We can defeat them!
Yeah! I made it!
Did you see that?
W-we made it!
Ow!
Aah!
Ow!
Sorry, I thought we could win...
W-we won! We did it!
Commander! It's summer! It's summer!
It's going to be a vitamin-filled summer!
The sea may be beautiful, but the sun can be very harmful. Be careful.
Would you like to take some vitamins before going for a dip?
What do you think of my swimsuit?
Commander! Come talk to me if you're tired of swimming.
Where have you been, Commander? Did you go for a swim?
Ah, this feels nice. I love working at the hospital, but it's nice to get out and have some fun once in a while.
We're going to set up a first aid station by the pool. Would you like to have a look?
How about a physical to celebrate the arrival of summer?
Isn't the sunshine wonderful? What a lovely day to swim in the sea.
Let's strengthen our bodies and minds! This will be an awesome and healthy summer for all of us!
Thanks! I think I just got healthier.
You're still so busy, even during the summer.
Thanks to you, Commander, I'll have a super healthy summer.
Oh my goodness, this is amazing!
I'm always so touched by your gifts, Commander.
I'll repay you, I promise!

Next time, I want to go to the sea with you alone...
If that's okay with you, heh-heh.
I don't know if it's the summer weather or you, but I'm feeling a bit emotional.
From now on, I want to be the vitamin that energizes and protects you. Can I?
Let's stick together while we're at the resort.
Let's make this fight cool and refreshing!
Over there?
Ah! Watch out!
Don't get hurt before you go for a swim.
The medic is right beside you!
We won't let this heat get the best of us!
I've gotta regroup and give it another go.
This is a bit tougher than I expected.
There's no rush.
Commander!
Vitamins recharged! I can do it!
It's time to go all out!
Germs eliminated!
Treatment complete!
Wow!
Gah!
That hurt...
Uh...
Sorry, I may have gotten carried away since it's summer...
Summertime victory!
